connectivity_not_configured.description:
{device_name} ({serial_number}) has no connectivity set up. Until it has, the device only turns on Bluetooth for a short time after its button is pressed, so the Airthings BLE integration cannot read its measurements regularly.

To fix this, in the Airthings app:
- If the device is not in the app, add it. If the app asks how to connect, select **I prefer to connect with Bluetooth**.
- If the device is already in the app, open its settings and select **Reset connectivity**.

This issue is resolved automatically when Home Assistant reads the device and it reports Bluetooth connectivity. Home Assistant tries every {update_interval} minutes.
connectivity_not_configured.title: {device_name} connectivity is not set up

connectivity_smartlink.description:
{device_name} ({serial_number}) uses SmartLink connectivity, which the Airthings BLE integration does not support. In this mode, the device only turns on Bluetooth for a short time after its button is pressed, so the integration cannot read its measurements regularly.

If you want to keep using SmartLink:
1. Set up the [Airthings integration]({airthings_url}) and sign in to your Airthings account.
2. Delete this device from the Airthings BLE integration.

If you want to use Bluetooth instead:
1. In the Airthings app, open the settings of {device_name}.
2. Select **Connectivity**, then **Switch to Bluetooth**.
3. Press the button on the device when the app asks you to.

This issue is resolved automatically when Home Assistant reads the device and it reports Bluetooth connectivity. Home Assistant tries every {update_interval} minutes.
connectivity_smartlink.title: {device_name} uses SmartLink connectivity
